summary: scripts/st-test asks the verifier once for all the crates (evidence-verify --members, which reads each record once per process and checks the members side by side: 110 s to 8.6 s on the same input, identical answer), shows rust-tests' real time and a setup row in its table, and pushes the per-crate records in chunks of 40 refs with a retry of the refs that failed

replay.detail: CI and local tooling only; no product code changes.

compatibility.detail: No product contract change. The verifier's answers are the same; it only reads each record once per process and runs the per-member checks concurrently.
